mapper.select: SELECT v.*, o.name AS owner_name, CONCAT(b.building_name, '-', h.room_no) AS house_address FROM t_visitor v LEFT JOIN t_house h ON v.house_id = h.id LEFT JOIN t_owner o ON v.owner_id = o.id LEFT JOIN t_building b ON h.building_id = b.id WHERE v.id = #{id}

SELECT v.*, o.name AS owner_name, CONCAT(b.building_name, '-', h.room_no) AS house_address FROM t_visitor v LEFT JOIN t_house h ON v.house_id = h.id LEFT JOIN t_owner o ON v.owner_id = o.id LEFT JOIN t_building b ON h.building_id = b.id
AND (v.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryString}, '%') OR v.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{queryString}, '%'))
AND v.status = #{status}
ORDER BY v.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_visitor (name, phone, owner_id, house_id, reserve_time, access_method, status, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{name}, #{phone}, #{ownerId}, #{houseId}, #{reserveTime}, #{accessMethod}, #{status}, #{remark}, NOW())
